Comments: Mobile money operators are widespread and support domestic peer-to-peer transfers; IMF notes MNO mobile money is main driver and P2P is a popular service, and the new instant payment service enables wallet-to-bank and bank-to-bank instant transfers.

Definition: Whether consumer protection legislation or regulations specifically address digital payment services, covering disclosure requirements, liability allocation for unauthorized transactions, error resolution procedures, and user rights.
Comments: Sierra Leone has a Consumer Protection Act (2020) and launched the National Consumer Protection Commission in Nov 2024; additionally, UNCDF documents BSL working on standalone consumer protection guidelines for regulated financial institutions, supporting payment consumer protection/dispute handling framework.

Definition: Whether national data protection or privacy legislation exists and explicitly covers payment transaction data, including provisions on data collection, storage, sharing, retention, and user rights over their payment data.
Comments: Credible sources indicate Sierra Leone has been consulting on a draft data protection law (Right to Access Information and Data Protection Regulatory Commission Bill) and lacks a comprehensive enacted data protection law as of 2025; therefore no general data protection legislation coverage confirmed.
